verdict.rationale: Convex's CLI docs say that when you change a function or the schema, `npx convex dev` pushes it and automatically updates the generated types in convex/_generated. The marketing site also claims end-to-end type safety, so automatic typed client code generated from the schema is a documented first-party capability. missing for 10: detailed documentation of what the generated types and client API contain, independent or hands-on corroboration of the codegen in practice.
